CLUDS has the following steps: preprocessing, instance labeling, combining labeled and unlabeled data, and prediction. In preprocessing step Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) algorithm is used. In instance labeling step Logistic Regression is applied. In CLUDS, relevance values computation has been applied as a supervised term weighting methodology in the text classification field.
